name: Municipal Corporation of the City of Navsari
headquarters: Dudhiya Talav Ring Road, Asha Nagar, Navsari 396445
description: The district directory calls the corporation Navsari Mahanagarpalika. Gujarat constituted it on 1 January 2025 from Navsari-Vijalpor Municipality and the Dantej, Dharagiri, Eroo and Hansapore gram panchayats.
